pixel_convention: full-resolution pixels, x right, y down, origin top-left

camera.motion: static (phase-correlation shift vs frame 0 < 0.03 px on house and ground patches, all frames)
camera.focal_length: unknown; estimate from depth_info + a known size

perspective_cues.ground_plane: grass lawn rising to the house base; tree-trunk base at y~1550 (near), house base y~1365 (far), cart wheels touch ground y~1435
perspective_cues.horizon_estimate_y_px: roughly 1000-1100 (ground meets far hedge/forest ~ y 1300-1330; true horizon hidden by trees; camera looks roughly level, vertical house edges near-vertical)

crow.description: black bird (crow/raven) flying left-to-right in front of the house gable, flapping wings; the only bird; casts a faint shadow on the lawn below (y~1370-1390)
crow.reference_point: mask centroid (cx, cy) ~ body centre; bbox centre also given
crow.path_px: x 1029 -> 1758 (frames 0 -> 59), y oscillates 1034-1106 (wingbeat + slight climb near frame 50-55)
crow.apparent_size_px: bbox_w (wingspan proxy) 55-160; ~100-130 frames 16-40, ~120-150 frames 41-59 (slightly growing: crow likely approaching camera a little or wings more spread); wings-up frames have smallest bbox_h (~36-45: frames 23-24, 41, 58), wings-spread/down frames largest (~90-100: frames 36-38, 52-55)
crow.quality: frames 5-15 partial mask (crow against dark foliage and eave post), centroid biased left; other frames good

black_fuzzy_ball.description: black, fuzzy/furry roughly spherical object close to the camera at the left: sits on a branch partly behind the big tree trunk, falls/drops down beside the trunk and lands on the lawn near the trunk base at about (295,1544); no bounce. Could be a furry ball or small dark animal (rests as a dome on the ground). Only such object.
black_fuzzy_ball.reference_point: mask centroid (cx, cy); bbox centre also given
black_fuzzy_ball.path_px: on branch ~(219,1072) frames 0-15; drifts down slowly 16-23; clearly falling from ~frame 24; accelerating downward (dy/frame ~4 at f24-31, ~10 at f36, ~20 at f40, ~30 at f42-47, ~40-46 at f49-50); x drifts right 215 -> 295; lands frame 50 at (294.6,1543.9)
black_fuzzy_ball.apparent_size_px: fully visible only frames ~38-43: diameter ~120-135 px (bbox), eq_diam ~110-120; earlier masks are smaller only because trunk/leaves hide part of it (de-occlusion, not approach); frames 44-49 motion blurred (elongated 140 px along motion, ~85 across); on ground 134 wide x 75 tall dome (lower part hidden by grass / flattened)
black_fuzzy_ball.quality: frames 0-31 occluded (trunk/leaves), 44-49 motion blur, 50-59 static on ground

events.event: crow in flight at start (already moving)
crow passes the left eave corner of the house (low-contrast stretch)
crow still flying at end, right part of roof
ball starts moving (slow drift begins ~16, clear fall by 24; uncertain +/-4 frames)
ball hits ground (first frame at rest position; no bounce)

house.desc: timber-framed barn/house with gable facing camera, crossed beams at roof peak, broken shingle roof

doorway_open.desc: dark open doorway, centre of gable wall

door_leaf.desc: closed wooden plank door left of doorway

barrel_left.desc: wooden barrel left of pair, front of house right of doorway

cart.desc: wooden hand cart with large spoked wheels, right edge, cut off by frame

white_flower_bush.desc: small white flower bush at house left corner

big_tree_left.desc: large tree in foreground left; trunk x~100-185, crown fills top-left; ball sits on its branch

bright_tree_behind_house.desc: tall bright-green tree behind house left

lawn.desc: grass ground with tree-shadow patches and a small mound bottom-centre (~x 1000-1400, y 1530-1650)
